title: G Chord for Beginners: Song picks, 6/8 rhythm, and dynamics
summary: This JustinGuitar lesson centers on selecting beginner-friendly songs that feature the G major chord (the new chord introduced in Lesson 6). It showcases concrete song options (including Unknown Legend and Hey Joe) to practice G along with related major chords, and it explores 6/8 timing with This Year’s Love while highlighting other G-inclusive tunes like Mad World and County Roads. The host emphasizes practicing with simple chord progressions (C, G, D, A, E), using left-handed practice, and maintaining motivation by choosing songs learners truly enjoy, with a note that the next lesson will consolidate skills and sustain momentum.
topics: Hey Joe – C G D A E (left-handed practice)
6/8 time and This Year’s Love (David Gray)
Mad World – dynamics and chord changes
Simple chord progressions (C G D A E)
Consolidation and motivation in later lesson
